purpose: Ask the host system that owns the GPUs for GPU time and talk with it about that time through one signed mailbox: request, ack, you're clear with X, 5-minute warning, owner order, release.
triggers: after a restart, do I hold GPU time
owner_approval: creating the mailbox (gpu_time.py init) is an install step the owner approves
any action on the host system outside the mailbox (this skill only asks for time and answers)
evaluation: tools/gpu_mailbox/test_gpu_time.py: temp-dir mailbox; request -> ack -> grant -> check -> release, signature and append-only checks, forged and stale grants refused, minutes bounds.

provenance.license: unspecified (the repo owner picks one before publishing)

portability: Standard-library Python; the mailbox is plain signed JSON files any future host can read.
